name: Jataayu Security Guard
description: Prompt-injection screening, capability authorization and outbound protection with configurable enforcement modes.

python.description: Path to Python interpreter with jataayu installed (e.g. a conda/venv python)

jataayuPath.description: Optional path to the jataayu package if not importable on sys.path

protectedNames.description: Names/tickers the outbound guard should redact from shared surfaces

blockOnInboundHigh.description: Block HIGH-risk non-owner input. Owner input bypasses blocking. Screening errors block non-owner input.

classifierMode.description: off = no classifier. shadow = consult the injectiond sidecar alongside the regex gate and LOG its verdict; changes NO gate outcome. There is deliberately no gate/block mode.

classifierUrl.description: Base URL of the injectiond injection-classifier sidecar (POST /score).

classifierTimeoutMs.description: Hard deadline for the shadow /score call. On timeout/error the record notes classifier_error and the gate outcome is unchanged.

llmBackend.description: Transport Jataayu uses to REWRITE leaky outbound content. Must be one the library knows: gateway|ollama|openai|anthropic. 'openclaw' is NOT a backend name -- it was set here for weeks and silently made every rewrite fall back to deterministic redaction (94 messages).

llmModel.description: Model id for llmBackend. For 'gateway' these are the ids at <gateway>/v1/models, i.e. openclaw/<agent>, which run that agent's own model.

llmUrl.description: Base URL for llmBackend, host root WITHOUT /v1 (e.g. https://localhost:18789). Passed explicitly rather than via JATAAYU_GATEWAY_BASE_URL because env.vars does not reach plugin child processes on this deployment.

llmToken.description: Bearer for llmBackend='gateway'. Must equal gateway.auth.token.

recoverUseLlm.description: Let the LLM rephrase flagged outbound content. False = deterministic redaction only.

recoverAttempts.description: LLM rewrite rounds before falling back to redaction.

llmInsecureTls.description: Waive TLS verification for llmBackend='gateway'. Needed because gateway.tls.autoGenerate serves a self-signed cert. Honoured ONLY for the gateway backend on a loopback llmUrl, so it cannot silently disable verification against a remote endpoint.

effectBoundaryMode.description: Authorize every tool call against provenance and capability policy. Enforce blocks or requests approval; shadow records decisions; off disables the hook.

effectApprovalMode.description: What a NEEDS_APPROVAL verdict does. block = deny immediately with a reason (deterministic). ask = requireApproval, which pauses the run behind a real approval prompt; on a chat surface that can stall the turn until timeout, and an unresolved approval always denies.

effectTimeoutMs.description: Screening deadline in milliseconds. Enforce withholds on failure; shadow records the failure and passes through.

toolReturnMode.description: Awaited OpenClaw tool-result screening plus legacy hook coverage. Enforce withholds HIGH-risk results or screening failures; shadow records decisions.

toolReturnTimeoutMs.description: Screening deadline in milliseconds. Enforce withholds on failure; shadow records the failure and passes through.

skillVetMode.description: Supply-chain screening on before_install. Enforce blocks unsafe verdicts and screening failures; shadow records decisions.

effectLedgerPath.description: Where Phase-2 decisions are appended as JSONL. Empty = ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/jataayu-effect.jsonl

openclawBin.description: Explicit path to the openclaw binary for out-of-band operator alerts. Empty = resolve from ~/.local/bin, PATH, then the node execPath sibling.

alertDiscordTarget.description: Discord target for withheld-credential alerts, e.g. user:<id>. Empty = alerts cannot be sent and the boot log says so.

trustedSenders.description: Sender identifiers treated as the owner by the inbound gate. Transport-attributed only; message content can never confer this (LIT-159).

ownerIdentifiers.description: Owner sender identifiers. Falls back to trustedSenders when unset.

strictProtectedNames.description: Names the outbound guard redacts from shared surfaces under a strict word-boundary match.

capturePath.description: Where every inbound gate decision is appended as JSONL. Empty = ~/.openclaw/workspace/tools/jataayu_inbound_capture.jsonl

captureMaxChars.description: Cap on captured inbound content per record.

captureFullContent.description: Store the entire inbound content rather than only the scanned tail. Default false: the full body can carry PII and secrets.
